images.caption: Figure 1:GameDojo: a controlled and challenging arena for interactive agents.The benchmark spans 20 games and 120 boss encounters in diverse interaction patterns, supporting the study of model capabilities, algorithms, and agent harnesses.

Figure 2:Overview ofGameDojo.(1) Human-selected games and bosses guide coding agents that build environments and behavior-tree controllers from videos, wikis, and mechanics descriptions.
(2) Scripts, LLM agents, and policy networks interact through configurable action interfaces, timing modes, and difficulty settings.
(3) Parallel rollouts produce high-qualityGameDojo-Data efficiently without any manual gameplay.
(4) The suite supports learning from generalist models and training specialist policies from scratch.
(5) Shared tasks evaluate model capabilities, algorithms, and agent harnesses.

Table 2:Task coverage: nine interaction patterns and reference games used in environment design.
The grid shows one boss encounter from each of the 20 reconstructed environments.
